messages:
eli: heads up — deploy-bot blocked the image publish for redwood/runtime:release-202603 to prod-eu, flagged a provenance mismatch on the manifest. Holding canary rollout.

deploy-bot: publish halted — attestation check failed (cosign timestamp TTL). failing layer `sha256:abc123def...`. See CI: https://ci.internal/build/789 :warning:

maria: :eyes: which stage? canary only or full? logs?

deploy-bot: canary hasn't been promoted. attempted push at 2026-03-18T14:12Z. Attestation header `timestamp` outside allowed window.

maria: paste of relevant snippet:
```
Error: attestation timestamp 2025-12-10T02:03:04Z outside accepted window
cosign verify: signature timestamp expired
```

dan: do we have the original signed artifact stored? if yes we can retag by digest instead of tag push.

sasha: artifact is in s3 `s3://ci-artifacts/runtime/2026-03-18/789/image.tar` and digest `sha256:deadbeef...`. cosign attestations stored alongside at `s3://ci-artifacts/runtime/2026-03-18/789/cosign.intoto.json`

ci-bot: artifact `sha256:deadbeef...` exists in us-west-2 and eu-central-1 registries; attestation TTL shows `issued_at: 2024-11-01T00:00:00Z`.

eli: plan: short-term — modify deploybot to pin the canary to `sha256:deadbeef...` and continue canary at 1% while we re-run signing pipeline and republish attestation. Long-term — add attestation TTL check to publishing pipeline so build signs with fresh timestamp.

maria: +1. I'll open a quick PR to deploybot to add `fallback_to_digest: true` for the canary route. ETA 30m.

dan: If pb to retag, we need release notes update and ops note. I'll draft the rollback entry: 'pinned canary to previous digest due to provenance attestation expiry; republish scheduled.'

sasha: I'll kick off re-sign job after PR merges and ping when done.

eli: ok - action items: maria PR, sasha re-sign, dan doc. tagging this incident `provenance-hold`.

maria: PR merged. deploybot updated. canary continuing at 1% with pinned digest.

ci-bot: new attestation uploaded and verified for `sha256:deadbeef...` — signature timestamp now `2026-03-18T14:45Z` :white_check_mark:

eli: applause, thanks team. follow-up: add TTL guard to release pipeline. closing thread once doc is in release notes.

dan: adding to release notes now.
